- Spring (April-May) and Fall (September-October): Ideal times with mild temperatures, fewer tourists, and beautiful landscapes
- Winter (December-February): Great for skiing in the Julian Alps, Christmas markets in Ljubljana

- More affordable than Italy

- Smaller and less touristy compared to its neighbors
